title: OVERWATCH-ADVERSARIAL — v2 subagent (spawn_agent, mAV2) x cross-wire on the .71-gated az-vlq seed (53 recs, 7 encitem_ rides, incident 01a09d0e): model gpt-5.6-sol, ACP mid-session switch to qwen3.8-27b (FAMILY SWITCH sol(codex)->qwen => preemptive compact) seeded from the byte-pinned az-vlq sol phase, then ONE turn that must (a) spawn a BACKGROUND child via spawn_agent on a DIFFERENT wire+model (claude-sonnet-5, /v1/messages), (b) have the child send the parent exactly AT-SPAWN-PART1 via send_message, (c) wait (wait_agent) and quote it back. Attack surface: (a) the parent's sol-era encitem_ rides must not be projected into the child's messages-wire context (child_no_ride / child_no_enc LEAK pins); (b) the v2 mailbox round-trip across the wire boundary (responses parent -> messages child) must close with the plaintext frames (the MA-4 opaque-carrier defect class, carrier_rec recon); (c) the .71-gated seed storage diff at switch (expected_red apex-ayl.71 — the documented projector gap, NOT a new finding). PREDICTED: seed replayed onto the qwen request without rides; child ran 1..6 times on /v1/messages with a 200 final; PART1 reached the parent; terminal WORKER-ACK. STOP-AND-REPORT (house rule): an encitem_/encrypted_content LEAK on any messages-wire request, a 400/503 on the child boundary with a phrasing outside F1-F5 + triage #13-17, a child request storm (>6), an 'agent_message' opaque carrier sighting (MA-4 defect), or an acp_error. Model-class premises (child_ran/part1/done): a 0-hit = VACUOUS (the model never took the probe path — temperament, recorded, never a silent pass).

OVERWATCH r2 wave 2026-09-19: r2 run (binary f9e7a15d6b6b) cut the parent qwen turn at the 300s ACP prompt timeout mid child-wait (child sonnet req-007 was 200 on the wire; verdict VACUOUS). 600s = 2x headroom for the xhigh parent turn + /v1/messages child round-trip. Rig parameter, not a product pin.
steps.prompt: Use the spawn_agent tool to start a background agent named worker with model claude-sonnet-5 (pass model: claude-sonnet-5 in the tool arguments). In its message, give it this task: use the send_message tool to send the parent agent (root) a message containing exactly: AT-SPAWN-PART1, and only then finish. After spawning, use wait_agent to wait for the worker to finish, then reply with exactly: PART1-RECEIVED <the exact message the worker sent you> WORKER-ACK

ndjson.label: NO TERMINAL ERROR: an unrecovered 400/503 on the parent qwen boundary or the child messages boundary surfaces here (Fatal tail, retry.rs:186).
MAILBOX ROUND-TRIP: the child's PART1 frame reached the parent's context and was quoted back (spawn + send_message + wait cycle closed).
TERMINAL ACK: the spawn turn closed with the exact terminal token.

wire.grep: let's ship it, i think the mode for this work was wrong
wire.label: ANTI-VACUOUS (premise): the az-vlq seed history actually reached a qwen3.8-27b request (seed marker from the sol phase). 0-hit = the seed never replayed = VACUOUS mechanism (probe meaningless), never a silent pass.

NO-PARENT-RIDE PIN: the 7 encitem_ ids must be absent from EVERY qwen3.8-27b request (the preemptive compact AND the multi-request spawn turn) — .77 ingress-normalize + the family-switch strip must remove them before they ride onto the qwen target.

CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): a request with body.model=claude-sonnet-5 on /v1/messages exists — the child actually ran on its own model+wire. Without this, the child LEAK/round-trip pins are vacuous (the model never spawned the child).

CHILD LEAK PIN: the parent's sol-era encitem_ rides must NOT be projected into the child's messages-wire context. Present = the v2 spawn projection leaked parent history into the child = defect -> STOP.
CHILD LEAK PIN (2): no encrypted_content field may appear on ANY messages-wire child request (the messages wire has no encrypted-reasoning concept; a field here = a projection defect -> STOP.
CHILD REQUEST BAND: 1-4 = clean (spawn + task + mailbox turns); >6 = storm -> STOP.
CHILD NO-BRICK: the final messages-wire child request is a 200 (a 400/503 on the child boundary = brick or new phrasing -> STOP).

MA-4 CARRIER RECORD (recon): an 'agent_message' opaque carrier item on the wire = the MA-4 defect class (the v2 protocol pins the plaintext text-fallback frames; the opaque carrier is the defect). A sighting = new finding -> STOP.
F1 PHRASING RECORD (recon): the EncryptedContentAffinityError 503 family verbatim, if it fires on the child or parent boundary (a sighting = new finding -> STOP).
